alignments.note: Assimilated article takes the written the (rule 12).

One substantive rendered by two words; the ASV never writes Musician alone for נָצַח, so the supplied generic is Musician and the lexeme (preeminence/direction) sits on Chief (rule 31). Heading on Musician is the competing reading.

עַל rendered by the fixed phrase set to. Rule 24: a preposition rendered by a fixed phrase built on a relational content word and closed by a colourless to heads on the content word, never on the connective (as according to → according, out of → out); the more than → than ruling reaches only a degree adverb, which set is not. Heading on to is the competing reading.
